[[File:Kneesaa_slingshot.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Princess [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] using her slingshot against [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] (in his bad dream of episode ''Horville's Hut of Horrors'').]]
'''Slingshots''' were weapons used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. The weapon was fired by first loading the slingshot with a rock or other small miscellaneous object, then pulling the string back. When the string was all the way back, it would be released, launching the projectile at a target. Slingshots would differ in damage, depending on the projectile. Many slingshots were used during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
